title: Northern Vietnam in 7 days
summary: Hanoi plus either the mountains or the bay and Ninh Binh. Seven days is not Hanoi, Ha Long, Sapa, and Ha Giang.

days.title: Day 1 — Hanoi
days.body: Land in Hanoi and walk the Old Quarter, and do not leave the city the hour you arrive.

days.title: Day 2 — Hanoi
days.body: Walk Hoan Kiem Lake, see the Imperial Citadel of Thang Long, and eat bun cha.

days.title: Day 3 — One region
days.body: Leave for Sa Pa, or for Ha Giang, or for Ha Long and Ninh Binh, and keep it to that one region.

days.title: Day 4 — Sa Pa
days.body: See the stone church, then walk to Cat Cat.

days.title: Day 5 — Fansipan
days.body: Ride the cable car to Fansipan, or walk a valley village if Cat Cat was enough.

days.title: Day 6 — Back to Hanoi
days.body: Return to Hanoi and keep the evening free.

days.title: Day 7 — Hanoi
days.body: Stay in Hanoi so a delay does not become a missed flight.

seoDescription: A one-week northern itinerary that picks a single landscape beyond Hanoi.
